conventions.name: package-layout
conventions.description: Every workspace package ships package.json, tsconfig.json, and a README.md (CLAUDE.md lists the package README as a mandatory documentation surface)

conventions.name: package-barrel
conventions.description: Every library package exposes a src/index.ts barrel (cli and create-agentback are bin-first packages without one)

conventions.name: client-bundle-typecheck
conventions.description: A package with an esbuild client bundle (build-client.mjs) must have tsconfig.client.json, or CI's typecheck:client silently skips it

conventions.name: unit-test-naming
conventions.description: Files under __tests__/unit/ must use the .unit.ts suffix — vitest only globs dist/**/*.{test,spec,unit,integration,acceptance}.js and the suffix should match the directory

conventions.name: integration-test-naming
conventions.description: Files under __tests__/integration/ must use the .integration.ts suffix

conventions.name: acceptance-test-naming
conventions.description: Files under __tests__/acceptance/ should use the .acceptance.ts suffix; helpers belong in __tests__/fixtures or __tests__/support

conventions.name: test-files-import-vitest
conventions.description: Test files import from vitest directly (the excluded messaging runners delegate to the shared conformance suite, which imports vitest itself)

conventions.name: no-direct-debug-import
conventions.description: CLAUDE.md logging rule: use loggers from @agentback/common everywhere; only common's debug utils may import the debug npm package

conventions.name: no-cjs-lodash
conventions.description: ESM-only workspace: import lodash-es, never lodash

conventions.name: mcp-stays-express-free
conventions.description: CLAUDE.md: mcp-http exists so @agentback/mcp stays Express-free — the mcp package must never import express

conventions.name: client-stays-browser-safe
conventions.description: CLAUDE.md: @agentback/client has no @agentback/openapi runtime dep (browser-safe) — both ends share Zod schemas instead

conventions.name: example-layout
conventions.description: Examples are a documentation surface (CLAUDE.md): each should ship package.json, tsconfig.json, and a README.md
